Mortified is a comic excavation of adolescent writing, art & media. PS: It totally likes you.

description:
Pisces Music presents
SECRET PSYCHEDELICA: LEO 2026

Above DNA:

  Ghreg on Earth
  Barcellos
  A Living Earth
  Krissh
  Michael Liu

Dazzle Room:

  Treeko
  Rayne
  Sneakerz
  Ergot

Secret Psychedelica continues its monthly zodiac march and enters the second half of 2026 with its 6th annual Leo psytrance celebration! This year's lineup features a majestic coalition of lions ready to unleash their psychedelic roar on the dance floor. Holding court at the center of the pride are two fierce Leo producers: the return of legendary mind-bender Ghreg on Earth alongside the powerhouse sounds of Barcellos. Together with a supporting cast of bold, fire-sign talent, they are set to bring maximum psytrance for the night!

Ghreg on Earth has been ruling the electronic music stage since 1989, commanding the spotlight with his fierce and unyielding psy-adjacent anthems. Exuding ultimate psychedelic energy, he drops sonic masterpieces on his own on3rth Media label, alongside noble releases on Mindfull Records and Wirikuta Recordings. Like a true lion king, he has been boldly forcing crowds to rethink everything they knew about music though his five legendary studio albums and a royal treasury of compilation features. Prepare for his supreme takeover at Secret Psychedelica--this golden-tier set is strictly for the brave and lion-hearted!

Hailing from the sun-drenched lands of Curitiba, Brazil, Barcellos was destined to shine in the spotlight. His musical awakening struck in 2006 at just 12 years old when his cousin showed him videos of Brazilian raves. It was love at first sight. By 2017, this natural-born star claimed his rightful place under the neon lights in the San Francisco scene before taking his talents across the US. Not content with playing other people's tracks, Barcellos leveled up in 2020 by stepping into the studio to engineer his own heavy-hitting tunes. With three critically acclaimed releases under his belt and a treasure trove of unreleased anthems, he has shared the stage with fellow titans like Vibe Tribe, Berg, and Mad Maxx. As the mastermind behind DaleCali BR and the Silver Panda project, his magnetic presence makes his sets an unmissable spectacle for electronic music lovers.

In addition to the two Leo virtuosos, the psytrance room will ignite with an opening set by Droid9's very own icon, Krissh, and finish with a grand closing set by A Living Earth of Techno Trance Thursday. The second room growls with drum & bass hosted by East Bay's Amalgam Collective, the legendary crew recognized for bringing the heat in the back room of Secret Psychedelica's Capricorn and Gemini parties earlier this year. The adventure begins with a proud, high-octane jungle journey curated by Ergot, Treeko, and Sneakerz, before transforming into a dramatic showcase of hard dance flavors delivered by the radiant Rayne from Hardcore in the Bay and 1becoming11, the artist formerly known as Nexus.

And of course, Secret Psychedelica resident and Michael Liu will be on hand to fill in the gaps. Come celebrate with the Lions! All PSYgns welcome!!

Prescott Niles' The Knack: Prescott Niles is the founding bassist whose unmistakable playing helped define The Knack's signature sound--lean, melodic, and relentlessly propulsive. Long before the band's meteoric rise, Niles built a deep musical foundation, recording with Hendrix associate Velvert Turner and later spending formative time in London, where he hobnobbed with the likes of George Harrison. Those experiences sharpened a sensibility that would become central to The Knack: classic pop economy delivered with the punch of a seasoned live unit. The Knack became a cultural surge powered by \"My Sharona\", propelled by Niles' phenomenal bass march--its staccato pulse and locked-in momentum as iconic as the riff itself. \"Good Girls Don't\", and deeper cuts, \"Let Me Out\", \"Your Number or Your Name\", and \"Maybe Tonight\" -- revealed a band fluent in dynamics, melody, and timeless songcraft, with Niles' musical pedigree and bass-first instincts shaping the snap, swing, and clarity of the arrangements. With the passing of several members and the retirement of another, Prescott Niles now carries that legacy forward as the driving force behind \"Prescott Niles' The Knack\" -- an authentic continuation celebrating the sound that made the band essential. For longtime fans and new listeners alike, it's an opportunity to experience the classic songs with the founding bassist often credited as the band's signature sound--proof that the spirit of The Knack is not only preserved, but still thriving and evolving.

Directed by Alex Proyas and featuring a haunting score by Graeme Revell (formerly of pioneering 70s/80s industrial noise group SPK), the movie is an audio and visual triumph. Revell calls the score his \"signature work\".

Jeff Most, the film's producer, said: \"I went through the bands I wanted, and Trent Reznor was like, 'I love all these bands, but no one's gonna let you make this album, Jeff.' And I said, 'Trent, I really believe if you say yes, I'll be able to do it.' And he goes, 'I'm in. Can I pick whatever Joy Division song I want to do?' I said, 'Any one you want.'\"

title: An Evening With Black Flag
description:
Performing Live:

  BLACK FLAG

If unbridled anger and unfocussed rebellion have a soundtrack, it's Black Flag. Primarily the brainchild of songwriter/guitarist Greg Ginn, Black Flag welded the heaviest metal to avant-jazz's noisy atonality powered by the full-tilt rhythms of the highest energy punk. Black Flag completely made mincemeat out of punk's boundaries and are frequently hailed as being Americas first hardcore band. Now, Black Flag is officially turning the page and beginning a bold new chapter with the addition of three new members: Max Zanelly (vocals), David Rodriguez (bass), and Bryce Weston (drums), joining founding guitarist Greg Ginn. Decades after its formation, Black Flag remains loud, direct, independent, and continually pushing forward, carrying the same confrontational spirit from the underground clubs of the late 1970s to stages around the world today.

An Evening with Black Flag will showcase the chemistry and talent of the revitalized lineup, giving fans a taste of the new era while also reliving the bands classic hits with 2 full sets of pure Black Flag!
